description:
## What changed

The three controls Hushfeed draws over the video no longer sit on TikTok's own avatar, like and share column. Out of the box they were right on it, so a tap on the creator's face hid the creator instead of opening the profile. They start a finger's width to the left now, and a position you dragged them to is kept. Hiding a rail button also hides its count: Hide like button used to leave the number standing under an empty space, half under the avatar, which looked like the switch had done nothing.

Coming back to TikTok with "Do not start the feed on returning" on shows a "Tap to start the feed" label instead of a silent, frozen feed. TalkBack announces it once and can't swipe through it to the buttons underneath, and if you tap Profile or Inbox instead, the stop goes away on its own rather than eating your first tap there and holding the sound.

A change that needs a restart now leaves a row pinned to the top of every settings page, "Restart TikTok to apply this change" (or how many), and tapping it restarts TikTok. Before, the only sign was a toast that disappeared. Rows still waiting say "Restart pending", a switch flipped back to where it was owes nothing, and the row goes away once TikTok has been restarted.

Hide suggested accounts now covers every "People you may like" card, not only the inbox lists: the profile header, the Friends tab and the feed's account cards each build their own list, and every card is collapsed as it is bound and comes back at its own size when the switch goes off. Clear all in the inbox's suggested accounts counts as it goes and a second tap stops it. A boolean gate in the Feature Gate Lab has its own override switch, so an imported rule turns on with one tap, and the four actions on a selection wrap instead of clipping at large text. When a structured override can't be applied, the page says why and what to do about it, in all five languages.

The diagnostic report says more. Ghost mode names each place it answered and what it answered. The CAPTCHA gate is in every report as installed, logs the first write it sees go out and the first puzzle that reaches it, keeps the reason a puzzle was shown next to the line for one it hid, and puts all of that back after you clear the diagnostics. Comment translation reports what it found. The Lab's detail page puts its controls back when a save fails. The About page has a Licenses row. And the block, hide and sound chips no longer sit over a creator's profile opened from the feed, or over a story.

Hushfeed now needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. The bundle is built against patcher 1.13.0, which Manager 1.30.0 was the first stable release to ship.

## Validation

The release passed 1,331 runtime tests and 199 patch tests with no failures or skips. Both Android API checks passed. The bundle carries 79 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty.

All 79 patches applied with zero failures to the TikTok 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. The provenance receipt attached to this release records every verdict, the source commit and the bundle hash. Hushfeed targets the global TikTok 46.2.3 package. Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer is required.

On a Galaxy S22 running this build: two comments posted and landed, one with Hide CAPTCHA popups off and one with it on, and were deleted afterwards. The chips measured clear of the rail. The "Tap to start the feed" label appeared on return, the first tap removed it, and it left on its own when Profile was opened. Hide stories in inbox took the tray away and gave it back. Hide like button took the count with the heart. The pinned restart row restarted TikTok. Another creator's profile showed its real follower counts with Ghost mode on and off.
